narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The brick question is statistical because it says about.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>There is only one wall, and it has one number of bricks.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>We are estimating one count, and nothing varies, so it is not statistical.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>A statistical question needs many answers that vary, which we collect and sum up.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>One person, one object or one fixed count is not enough.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Sort these two: hours of sleep of students in your class, and the age of your grandmother.
